title: Companion publish gate review
description: Opens two runs parked at a publish gate under a one-review policy on a private fixture gateway; each gate's actions come from the gateway's own policy functions. The first has one proven criterion (a screenshot and a text check), one criterion with no verdict, and passing reviewers: run detail and the decision workspace both reach the gate review, approve-publish is disabled with its reason on both while hold and review requests stay enabled, the criterion's evidence opens in the artifact viewer and swipes within that criterion, and holding the gate resolves it on the gateway. The second has every criterion proven but a claude review with open findings: the gateway still offers approve-publish, and the gate review keeps it disabled with the review as its reason. Requires the leased iOS simulator and the dev client with the recipe bridge.

proofTargets.claim: A gate review screen for an engine_human_gate decision shows the package summary, each reviewer's latest verdict, the acceptance criteria, an evidence strip and the decision's actions, reached from run detail and the decision workspace.

Approve-publish is disabled with a visible reason while a registered criterion has no verdict or a reviewer's latest verdict is not an approval, on the gate review and the decision workspace; hold and review requests stay enabled.
Tapping a criterion's evidence opens the artifact viewer on that file with the criterion's verdict, proof mode and recipe node, and swiping stays within that criterion's evidence.
Gate actions resolve through the existing decision-resolve call: holding the gate resolves the decision on the gateway.
